agent_usage_note: Use Codex chat for narrative EDA first; this repo provides deterministic datasets, not an LLM agent runner.

recommended_questions: Which reserves combine efficiency and real minutes?
Which bench players swing matchups by opponent?

bench_team_game_2026.csv.grain: one row per team-game bench unit
recommended_questions: Which teams rely most on bench scoring?
Which benches are gaining or losing trust over time?
Which teams have the deepest second units?
Which bench profiles are efficient versus volume-only?

clutch_team_game_2026.csv.grain: one row per team-game clutch window
recommended_questions: Which teams create late-game scoring separation?
Where does clutch sample size limit conclusions?
Which player skill profiles complement team needs?
Where do spacing, rim pressure, and usage overlap?
How does All-Star value map to team grades?
Which non-headliners still shape team outcomes?

rapm_player_2026.csv.grain: one row per player when lineup validation passes
recommended_questions: Which RAPM-style signals agree or disagree with box-score value?
Which four-factor edges explain each team's grade?
Which defenses suppress opponent eFG and free throws?

purpose: EDA-ready dataset manifest for WNBA midseason team grades.
